role: descriptive benchmark arms; OUTSIDE the Holm family; primary arms and inference unchanged
naming_rule: default-h5 arms use published hyperparameters and may be called 'published/Qlib defaults (h5 label)'. tuned-h5 arms must never be called 'official/published default'.

data_convention.features: identical to v2 (same clean panel, filter_col_20, step_len_ts 20, VWAP0 handling as v2)

label.name: h5
label.processor: CSRankNorm per date over label_mask_h5: (rank(pct=True, method=average)-0.5)*3.46, mirroring DL-2 / v2 csrank_labels with r1->h5
label.used_for: train and validation labels only (as r1 in v2)

purge.rule: drop every train/valid sample whose h5 label endpoint dates[t+6] is after its segment end (train 2018-12-31, valid 2020-12-31); same rule as LiMT Data.loss_masks (limt-repro v2_w4_data.py:72-76)
purge.disclosure: default-r1 arms (v2) were NOT purged: r1 endpoint t+2 overlaps 1 day per boundary. Claude estimate of h5 cost: ~5 of ~2,500 train days, 4 of ~485 valid days; no sealed data touched either way

valid_ic5.definition: for each validation signal day t (BlindData.days('valid')): Pearson corr between score and z_h5[t] over loss mask = splits loss_mask_valid[t] & (dates[t+6]<=2020-12-31) & listing_eligible[t] & isfinite(score) & isfinite(z_h5[t]); same as limt-repro v2_w5_results.daily_ic (:85-103); metric = mean over days with defined IC

official_entry_v2.feature_processing_official: RobustZScoreNorm fit on official training window; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; model-specific FilterCol
official_entry_v2.feature_processing_ours: RobustZScoreNorm fit 2008-2018; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; VWAP0 set to 0; model-specific FilterCol
official_entry_v2.seed_policy: Explicit model seeds 1,2,3. Existing effective-seed-0 XGB/Transformer artefacts remain descriptive.

official_entry_v2.note: all other hyperparameters = class defaults of qlib v0.9.6 pytorch_transformer_ts.TransformerModel
official_entry_v2.feature_processing_official: RobustZScoreNorm fit on official training window; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; model-specific FilterCol
official_entry_v2.feature_processing_ours: RobustZScoreNorm fit 2008-2018; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; VWAP0 set to 0; model-specific FilterCol
official_entry_v2.seed_policy: Explicit model seeds 1,2,3. Existing effective-seed-0 XGB/Transformer artefacts remain descriptive.

Transformer.note: v2 passes only seed,n_jobs; all else = v0.9.6 class defaults (official metric '' = loss, early_stop 5, n_epochs 100, lr 1e-4, d_model 64). Tuned configs pass lr/d_model explicitly; nhead 2 divides 128.

unchanged_in_all_configs: every kwarg not listed in the grid stays at the official value, incl. n_epochs (LSTM 200, Transformer 100), early_stop patience (LSTM 10, Transformer 5), batch_size (800 / 8192), num_layers, dropout, loss mse, n_jobs, optimizer, reg

tuning_grid.cfg1_is_official: cfg1 = all official values = default-h5 configuration; cfg1 seed1 is ONE run counted both as default-h5 seed1 and as a tuning-pool member

selection.metric: valid_ic5 (mean daily 5d IC, 2019-2020) of the restored best checkpoint (the deployed model), for every config including valid_loss-stopped ones
selection.tie_rule: best = max IC over 8 configs; pool = configs with IC >= best - 0.002; within pool choose fewest non-official factors (n_nonofficial); then highest IC; then lowest cfg index
selection.nonfinite_or_failed: any failed/nonfinite config -> STOP and report (no selection)
selection.logging: stdout prints only the selected config name per model; per-config IC written to selection JSON file only
selection.bias_disclosure: valid_ic5-early-stopped configs are selected on the same metric and window they stopped on, so selection is optimistic toward them; this favours the tuned arm, i.e. errs toward fairness to the benchmarks and is conservative for the LiMT claim
selection.if_cfg1_selected: tuned-h5 IS default-h5: report as a finding ('the tuning budget selected the published configuration'), not as two arms; no extra runs

arms.LSTM-h5tuned: if k*!=cfg1: LSTM-h5tuned_cfg{k*}_seed{1,2,3}, seed1 = tuning run (disclosed); if k*==cfg1: no separate arm (finding)

run_count.per_model: 7 tuning-only (cfg2..cfg8 seed1) + 3 default-h5 (seed1 doubles as cfg1) + 2 tuned seeds 2-3 = 12; 10 if cfg1 selected
run_count.note: cfg1 seed1 is default-h5 seed1 (reused); each model that selects cfg1 saves 2 runs

compute.estimate_A10_hours: 5-8 (Claude, for 26); counts toward the 60 GPU-h cap (discretionary)
compute.accounting: GPU hours = GPU instance wall clock whenever an instance is up, incl. idle and debugging; sum of per-tag device time also logged for information

tag_naming.tuning: <Model>-h5tuned_cfg{k}_seed1 for k=2..8; cfg1 seed1 is stored ONCE as <Model>-h5default_seed1 and referenced as the cfg1 tuning-pool member

evaluation: eval-window books for these arms come only from the frozen descriptive script src/new_bench_eval_v1.py (arms listed in gate_b.json), never from v3.1; outside Holm

checkpoints.what: restored best-epoch state_dict per run, new_<tag>.pt
checkpoints.hash: sha256 recorded as artifact_sha256 in <tag>.meta.json; hard fail if missing or mismatched
checkpoints.upload: packed with metas into a separate dataset subdir, apart from the score archive
checkpoints.gate_b: all checkpoint sha256 listed in gate_b.json descriptive_arms[*].score_source

eval_scoring: evaluation period scored only at unseal by src/new_bench_eval_v1.py (imports src/new_guarded_data_v1.py); no eval-period prediction before unseal, including trial scoring (DL-28)
